name: glide
description: Open-source Screen Studio, built in Rust

paragraphs: A fast, fully open-source, native Rust screen recorder for polished product videos on macOS. Record your screen, a window, an area or an iPhone; Glide re-renders the cursor, zooms into what you click with spring animations, adds a background, shadow and rounded corners, and exports MP4 or GIF with the hardware encoder — usually several times faster than real time.

Behaviour was reverse engineered from Screen Studio using REA and Claude Code (see analysis/SCREENSTUDIO.md). Glide is not affiliated with or endorsed by Screen Studio or its authors and contains none of its code or assets: wallpapers, cursors, device frames, click sounds and the app icon are generated by Glide's own code.
features: Recording: display, window (picked on screen; follows the window), drag-selected area,

USB iPhone/iPad; system audio and microphone on separate tracks; camera; countdown, pause/resume, restart, cancel from a floating pill-shaped control bar that stays out of the recording; hide desktop icons and the Dock;…
Automatic zoom from clicks with cluster targeting and edge snapping,
spring physics and motion blur; manual and follow-mouse zooms.
Cursor re-rendered at high resolution with smoothing, tilt, press
